title: Welded Asteroids
description: The closed-loop stigmergic field itself, living on the quotient surfaces of the topology game: physarum agents, trail and agent-deposited momentum all obey the surface's gluing rule. Six tour levels bind surface + parameter presets + a beta_1 target; 18 declared sliders drive the physarum; the asteroids game survives as a hidden Easter egg (X when beta_1 >= 42).

cogdoc.claim: The closed-loop stigmergic field's native domain is a quotient surface: agent writes and reads both obey the surface's gluing rule (mirrored re-entry on Klein/projective/Mobius, walls on the strip), so the simulation itself provides the levels and the beta_1 readout is measured on the surface the structures actually live on.
